current_suggestion.pitch: Your poker content skews heavily GTO and solver-based; Jaffe adds a missing layer by grounding high-level theory in live and tournament contexts with explicit reasoning about population tendencies and exploitative adjustments. He covers hand history breakdowns, ICM pressure, and mental game elements that connect directly to your interest in decision-making under pressure. Format is mostly solo analysis and coaching sessions, pitched at mid-to-high stakes players who already understand GTO concepts but want to know when and why to deviate.

history: TEDx Talks – Russ Roberts (EconTalk host solo appearances)
EP Wealth Advisors (with Ben Felix-style rigor — try 'The Plain Bagel' instead)
Odyssey of the Mind (William MacAskill / 80,000 Hours)
